title: plain left open (kafka) — review required
description: plain runs with an open setting: listeners=PLAINTEXT://:9092. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply SASL_SSL listeners and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
